ModMetaData.name: 设施兼容补丁 RimFacilityCompat
ModMetaData.author: Cancelation
ModMetaData.description:
扫描所有已安装模组中的各类建筑，收集其声明的可链接设施（如各个mod中定义的衣柜、梳妆台等）。 首次启动默认不进行注入，首次启动请在设置界面配置。 配置界面有作者整理的预设，目前收录模组：鼠族（含金鸢尾兰扩展），绮罗，米莉拉，萌螈，原版扩展，边缘宜家，边缘仙路。
Scans buildings across all installed mods and collects the linkable facilities they declare (such as the wardrobes, dressers, etc. defined by each mod). No injection is performed by default; please configure the presets in the in-game settings on first launch. The settings screen ships with presets curated by the author, currently covering: Ratkin (incl. the Iris Expansion), Kiiro, Milira, Moelotl, Vanilla Expanded, Rimkea and RimImmortal.
